## Analysis

The quadratic tensor extension failed at its neutral coefficients, so degree-two coordinate warping adds no value to the 277-cell lineage. Together with failed linear folds, dilations, affine copies, and direct perturbations, this indicates the plateau is structural rather than a poorly tuned embedding. The 473-element incumbent is also capacity-constrained. Dense-core/fringe constructions remain underexplored: prior attempts used either tiny exhaustively swept fringes or unfocused annealing, whereas larger asymmetric fringes can change boundary sums and differences while a long core stabilizes the denominator.
